t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in pairs. Each gnome leads to different colour forests, some brighter than others. I need to concentrate and work out which gnome leads to the forest with the most mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: I am not too sure whether it works but I tried to keep an eye on which colour gnome gave me the most mushrooms. Sometimes it worked and sometimes it didn't. Try not to over think things as you may end up missing the click. I missed twice due to over thinking which gnome to pick and trying to look at the different forest.You will get into a rhythm of which gnome to pick and will find your pace of cliicking the buttons and the space bar
